scope: Shared first job for all 12 nations; 10 skills. VFX and casting asset preview, not combat implementation.
notes: User formulas copied verbatim in meaning; percentage bases are unresolved, not executable arithmetic.
Screen range must become a fixed world range before gameplay.
Skill and cooldown durations are source rules; VFX timings are provisional visual proposals.
Casting gesture is a reusable Medium ritual; effects distinguish each skill. No real damage or healing occurs in the asset preview.
2026-10-09 v2: five Active release effects redesigned following central art bible; all five Medium passives remain stat-only with no VFX.

skills.name: Spirit Bolt
skills.formula: MDMG = MATK × (1.0 + Lv × 0.15); ×1.3 ต่อ Undead/Demon
skills.target: เป้าหมายเดี่ยว
skills.visual: แกนวิญญาณพุ่งพร้อมเส้นอาคมทอง → หางพลังหยกสะบัด → แตกประกายเมื่อถึงเป้าหมาย
skills.motif: Keep a directional soul flame projectile, make it point exactly RIGHT with flame tails trailing LEFT, colors muted jade green and teal shadows with ivory core and antique gold thread accents. Broader flowing ghost-flame curls, tiny original woven diamond energy knots. Remove neon yellow-green. All art fits within 10px transparent margins. No circles, weapons, physical arrows, jewelry, runes, background, border. Crisp detailed pixel-art VFX only.
skills.motion: The rightward jade soul-fire core swells briefly then surges RIGHT, curling flame tails ripple left, antique-gold filaments twist around the spirit core, fine ivory and gold soul sparks peel off. In late frames the core flares at impact and breaks into tapering jade wisps and small motes. Keep EXACT jade/ivory/muted gold palette, no neon lime, no physical arrow, centered sprite, transparent background.

skills.motif: Preserve this EXACT open-center twin-stream layout and the transparent center. Enrich the thin streams into beautiful broad flowing JADE SPIRIT FLAMES with layered pixel clusters and curling forked wisps. Add smaller rising ivory soul embers and a few antique-gold woven diamond knots along the outer streams. Dramatic healing embrace, bright jade edge highlights, dark teal underside, graceful curved motion. EMPTY CENTRAL CORRIDOR for actor. No character, clothing, flower, stone, pedestal, floor, ground circle, portal, border, real script. High-quality crisp pixel-art VFX, transparency.
skills.motion: Two jade spirit streams gracefully sweep upward in staggered waves around the EMPTY transparent central corridor, their flame tips curl and fork, gold diamond knots drift upward along the streams, ivory motes rise continuously. In middle frames a radiant healing crest blooms along BOTH sides without filling the central space, then streams soften into thin trailing wisps and dissipating soul sparks. Keep hollow center, exact muted jade/ivory/gold palette and whole silhouette inside canvas. No character, flower, pedestal, floor, portal or new ring.

Replace the giant solid white core with a transparent hollow opening. Fit entire burst INSIDE 12 pixel transparent margins. Low horizontal perspective and dynamic asymmetric arcs, sharp crisp pixel art, no ordinary orange flames, no pedestal, no physical disc, no solid central badge, no characters, no background.

The transparent central opening stays clear. Rays reach a dramatic peak in middle frames then dissolve into small golden seal fragments. Keep EXACT weathered gold/bronze/parchment palette, no orange mundane fire, no solid white core, no floor, no character.

skills.name: Ghost Sight

skills.formula: MDEF = MDEF Base + 10 × Lv; เปิดเผย Cloaking/Hiding

skills.visual: เนตรพลังหยกเปิดทันที → เส้นไฟวิญญาณกางออก → ประกายอาคมจาง
skills.motif: Keep an almond eye silhouette but REMOVE all solid metal/jewelry surfaces. Make it airy translucent jade spirit LIGHT strokes with a small ivory soul iris, forked jade flame curls extending sideways, sparse antique-gold woven knot particles. Float as a momentary revelation flash, light and energetic, transparent empty spaces. No physical eyeball, no metal eyelids, no ornate statue, no purple, no platform, no floor, no UI border. Crisp pixel-art VFX.
skills.motion: The airy jade light eye opens immediately, its ivory soul iris briefly flashes, thin antique-gold knot sparks travel along the eyelid strokes, jade flame tails curl outward in one reveal pulse. The eye softly narrows and dissolves into sparse jade and gold motes. Keep airy thin spirit LIGHT and transparent gaps, no solid metal object or physical eye, no purple, no floor, centered within canvas.

skills.name: Binding Thread

skills.target: เป้าหมายเดี่ยว
skills.visual: ด้ายสีชาดม้วนเข้าระดับข้อเท้า → ปมยันต์ทองล็อก → เศษอาคมสีชาดคลายจาง
skills.motif: Recompose into a WIDE LOW ankle-height ellipse seen elevated three-quarter overhead: thin dark CRIMSON enchanted silk threads in two crossing elliptical loops, tiny antique gold woven knots and restrained ivory sparks. Empty transparent center. Remove the thick vertical rope strands and the bright solid orb. All loops fit inside 10px transparent margin. Original Thai binding-seal magic, not a sphere or physical basket. No floor, stone, pedestal, legs, character, border. Crisp detailed pixel-art VFX.
skills.motion: Crimson enchanted threads snake outward then tighten inward into two low elliptical ankle-level loops; gold knots travel along the threads then lock firmly, one short bright ivory spark at each knot. The low loops briefly pulse crimson and settle before threads unravel into tiny fading crimson and gold motes. Empty center, unchanged horizontal perspective, no white cage, no solid floor or pedestal. Keep the whole effect within transparent canvas margins.
